_note: Resource type = the nature of the artefact, independent of standardisation status (`maturity`) and of the knowledge it represents. v2.0.0: added specification family, reference-architecture, software-framework, ai-model, benchmark; removed the unused `framework` (split into reference-architecture and software-framework). `kind` is the finer sub-type from which the type is derived.

families.label: Ontologies & semantic models
families.summary: Machine-readable models of meaning and structure: ontologies, vocabularies, data schemas and modelling languages. The catalogue opens on this family.

families.label: Standards & architectures
families.summary: Normative documents and reference architectures that do not provide a machine-readable model of their own.

families.label: Engineering & AI technology
families.summary: Software frameworks, simulation platforms, AI frameworks, AI models, datasets and benchmarks.

items.label: Ontology
items.summary: Formal model of concepts and relations with defined semantics (e.g. OWL, Common Logic).

items.label: Vocabulary / taxonomy
items.summary: Controlled terms, thesauri, classification systems or lightweight RDF vocabularies.

items.label: Data schema / exchange format
items.summary: Information model, meta-model or file format for describing and exchanging engineering data (e.g. EXPRESS, UML/MOF, URDF).

items.label: Modelling language
items.summary: Language with defined syntax and semantics for building engineering models.

items.label: Technical standard / specification
items.summary: Normative document (requirements, test methods, terminology) without a machine-readable model of its own.

items.label: Reference architecture
items.summary: Documented architecture pattern describing how components should be organised.

items.label: Software framework / middleware
items.summary: Reusable software libraries, middleware or runtime used to build engineering systems (e.g. robotics middleware).

items.label: Simulation platform / environment
items.summary: Simulator, physics engine or simulation environment.

items.label: AI framework / toolkit
items.summary: Software for building, training or evaluating AI systems. Not a model itself.

items.label: AI model
items.summary: A model architecture or a trained model (with or without published weights). `details.aiModel.artefact` says which; weights carry their own licence scope.

items.label: Dataset
items.summary: Published collection of data with stated provenance and licence.

items.label: Benchmark / evaluation protocol
items.summary: Task suite, metric set or test protocol used to evaluate systems. Not training data.
